description: This vulnerability pattern occurs in modular consensus architectures where consensus and execution layers are separated (e.g., Ethereum post-merge, Cosmos with ABCI, Polkadot). The execution layer accepts finality assertions from the consensus layer without validating fundamental structural constraints.
trigger_condition: A Byzantine consensus client sends fork choice updates that finalize blocks not descended from the currently finalized block, exploiting missing ancestry validation in the execution layer's finality update handler.
